parole.significato: A coupon-based system of hitchhiking that operated in communist Poland from the 1950s until the 1990s.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Polish autostop, from French auto-stop, and this a pseudo-anglicism, from auto- (relating to cars) + stop (hitchiking).

parole.significato: A type of Polish meat patty.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Polish kotlet, borrowed from French côtelette, from Middle French costelette (“little rib”), from coste + -elette. Doublet of cutlet, kotleta, and partly katsu.
